events.title: We're joining Steam Next Fest! The demo now includes the main story "DEMØNS GATE
events.summary: We're joining Steam Next Fest: October 2026 (Oct 19–26, PT)! Available in Japanese, English and Simplified Chinese. Until now the demo only included the "Paintball Ops" part. From this update, the main story "DEMØNS GATE" is playable in the demo as well. The demo stays free, and save data is shared with the full game. Just launch the demo — the latest content is applied automatically, no re-download needed.

events.title: 体験版リリースのお知らせ！
events.summary: Demo Release Announcement!・Free to play — no purchase required, just like the full game!・Uses save data shared with the full game, so you can get a head start!・Enjoy Paintball (Survival Game) modes with absolutely no restrictions!・DLC purchases are not available from the demo.・The demo does not have a review feature — this is by Steam's design.

events.title: Release Date Postponed
events.summary: Today (May 29, 2026) was our planned release date, but this morning we received feedback from Steam Review asking us to resubmit. As a result, we are postponing the launch to late June 2026 or later.We sincerely apologize to everyone who was looking forward to release day.The feedback was primarily caused by a misalignment between Steam's stated requirements and our own interpretation. events.title: 2026年5月末リリースへの訂正
